about: The Color filter shot as a picture that plays by itself in the README: the whole screen beside the popover close up, as the shot's two panes have them, with nothing round them. Color filters clicked on, Intensity dragged from Low to High, Tint once round the colours, Color filters clicked off. The shot ends with Intensity at High and Tint's knob at the far end, so the loop dissolves back to its first frame
caption: It lives in the menu bar.
